specs.sug_degem: kpi:active, chart-fleet — join key; P/M split quoted in the lede (private vs commercial)
specs.tozeret_cd: chart-fleet — join key to the counts table (manufacturer code); names come from tozar
specs.tozeret_nm: chart-origin — only to infer the plant country when tozeret_eretz_nm is blank (suffix such as 'ד. קוריאה'; mostly Kia)
specs.tozar: chart-makes, chart-models, chart-ev, kpi:makes, insight:leader, table:makes
specs.degem_cd: chart-fleet — join key to the counts table (model code)
specs.degem_nm: skip: internal model code (e.g. 3E7E); kinuy_mishari is the readable name used
specs.shnat_yitzur: chart-fleet, chart-mix, chart-origin, chart-survival, chart-heat, insight:electrified — model year, the time axis of every trend; also join key
specs.gova: skip: 89% empty (recorded only for commercial models)
specs.mazgan_ind: skip: near-constant (air-conditioning on over 99% of vehicles)
specs.abs_ind: skip: near-constant (ABS on 100% of vehicles from the 2010 model year)
specs.kariot_avir_source: skip: raw source code of the airbag count; mispar_kariot_avir is used
specs.hege_koah_ind: skip: near-constant (power steering on over 99% of vehicles)
specs.halonot_hashmal_source: skip: raw source code of the power-window count
specs.mispar_halonot_hashmal: skip: near-constant in recent model years (four power windows on most cars); low analytic value
specs.argaz_ind: skip: meaning of the flag can't be established from the data and it is under 1% set
specs.ramat_gimur: skip: free-text trim level (6,800 distinct values)
specs.delek_nm: chart-fleet, chart-mix, chart-makes, insight:electrified, insight:ev, kpi:elec_ref — combined with technologiat_hanaa_nm into a powertrain class
specs.mispar_dlatot: skip: body-style proxy; merkav covers the body story
specs.mispar_moshavim: skip: body-style proxy (89% of the fleet seats five); merkav covers it
specs.kosher_grira_im_blamim: skip: towing capacity; 0 mixes 'not rated' with 'not allowed', so no clean distribution
specs.kosher_grira_bli_blamim: skip: towing capacity; 0 mixes 'not rated' with 'not allowed'
specs.sug_tkina_nm: skip: homologation standard (European/American); 90% European, low analytic value
specs.sug_mamir_nm: skip: 75% of the fleet 'unknown code 0' — too sparse
specs.technologiat_hanaa_nm: chart-fleet, chart-mix, chart-ev, kpi:ev_fleet, kpi:elec_ref, insight:ev — powertrain class (hybrid / plug-in / electric)
specs.kamut_CO2: chart-co2 — legacy NEDC CO2 series, shown only where it covers ≥25% of a year's vehicles
specs.kamut_NOX: skip: legacy NEDC pollutant, superseded by NOX_WLTP (used)
specs.kamut_HC: skip: legacy NEDC pollutant; HC not charted
specs.kamut_CO: skip: legacy NEDC pollutant; CO not charted
specs.madad_yarok: chart-zihum — green index median quoted in the section lede (999 = not computed, excluded)
specs.nikud_betihut: skip: finer safety score that ramat_eivzur_betihuty (used) bins into levels
specs.shlita_automatit_beorot_gvohim_mak: chart-local — series dropped automatically while local installs stay under 5%
specs.HC_WLTP: skip: secondary pollutant; NOx is the charted pollutant
specs.CO_WLTP: skip: secondary pollutant; NOx is the charted pollutant
specs.CO2_WLTP_NEDC: skip: NEDC-equivalent conversion of CO2_WLTP; 83% empty
specs.dg_metach_solela: skip: 90% empty; battery figure with mixed units
